caseNameFull: In re Rivera In re Rivera and In re Richards

opinions.text: Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. See this Court’s Rule 39.8. Petitioners are allowed until May 10, 1999, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to *1063submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
